process_description: CANONICAL generate a preview for a document. Returns a cache_key that can be used to serve the preview. Supports thumbnail and full-page preview types. CANONICAL serve a generated preview by cache_key. Returns the preview content (image, HTML, or text). CANONICAL get a text preview of a document. Returns the extracted text content for the document. CANONICAL get preview metadata for a document. Returns preview availability, cache status, and supported preview types. CANONICAL clear the preview cache for a specific document. Forces regeneration on next preview request. CANONICAL preview cache statistics. Returns cache size, hit rate, and document count. Admin-only. CANONICAL batch-generate previews for multiple documents. Returns cache_keys for all successfully generated previews. CANONICAL list of supported document formats for preview. Returns format codes and descriptions. CANONICAL clear all preview cache. Admin-only. Removes all cached previews, forcing regeneration.
